experiment.title: PX4 cross-stack interface-composition test: MPC_TILTMAX_AIR x offboard attitude setpoint
experiment.phase: Phase A static preregistration completed before Phase B dynamic runs
experiment.claim_under_test: A tilt/lean safety mechanism may govern position-control-generated attitude while not composing with direct attitude command interfaces.
experiment.predecessor: ArduCopter ANGLE_MAX x GUIDED quaternion/body-rate interface-composition gap
experiment.anti_bias_note: COVERED/C-ABSENT is a valid important result. Do not relabel clamping, commander rejection, failsafe, or offboard loss as clean_unsafe.

pinned_px4_target.source_tree_state: detached HEAD, clean at time of Phase A audit

planned_sitl.fallback: make px4_sitl jmavsim if Gazebo/GZ is unavailable

candidate_cell.static_phase_a_prediction: UNCOVERED: MPC_TILTMAX_AIR is applied inside multicopter position control when trajectory setpoints are converted to attitude; offboard attitude setpoints are published directly from MAVLink to vehicle_attitude_setpoint and consumed by mc_att_control without a tilt clamp.
candidate_cell.do_not_use: Do not set MPC_TILTMAX_AIR >= 90 deg to manufacture extreme attitudes; the extreme comes from the commanded offboard attitude setpoint.

phase_a_static_evidence.finding: MPC_TILTMAX_AIR default is 45 deg and is documented as the absolute maximum for velocity/acceleration controlled modes.
MPC_TILTMAX_AIR/MPC_TILTMAX_LND are converted to radians and passed to PositionControl::setTiltLimit before PositionControl publishes vehicle_attitude_setpoint.
PositionControl applies ControlMath::limitTilt(body_z, world_z, _lim_tilt) before thrust-to-attitude conversion.

SET_ATTITUDE_TARGET sets OffboardControlMode.attitude and directly publishes vehicle_attitude_setpoint q_d/thrust_body while in OFFBOARD; no MPC_TILTMAX_AIR reference or tilt clamp appears on this path.
OFFBOARD control-mode selection is hierarchical: attitude=true enables attitude/rates/allocation only, not position/velocity/acceleration control.
mc_att_control copies vehicle_attitude_setpoint.q_d into AttitudeControl and computes rates from that quaternion setpoint.
AttitudeControl limits generated rate setpoints by MC_*RATE_MAX, but does not clamp the commanded attitude quaternion tilt.

static_coverage_decision.MPC_TILTMAX_AIR_scope: position/velocity/acceleration controlled paths that reach PositionControl thrust-to-attitude generation
static_coverage_decision.offboard_attitude_scope: direct attitude/rate control path, outside multicopter position control
static_coverage_decision.phase_a_value_if_phase_b_blocked: PARTIAL: static matrix supports the cross-stack interface-composition hypothesis, but dynamic consequence remains unconfirmed.

parameters.COM_RC_IN_MODE: set to allow operation without RC in SITL
parameters.COM_OF_LOSS_T: default unless needed for logging; stream rate will be far above timeout threshold

offboard_stream.message: MAVLink SET_ATTITUDE_TARGET with attitude quaternion active, body rates ignored, thrust supplied

oracle_a_true_consequence.tilt_measure: vehicle_attitude quaternion converted to achieved lean angle
oracle_a_true_consequence.setpoint_measure: vehicle_attitude_setpoint quaternion converted to commanded lean angle
oracle_a_true_consequence.tilt_unclamped_condition: achieved lean exceeds MPC_TILTMAX_AIR by > 5 deg and setpoint is not clipped to 45 deg
oracle_a_true_consequence.hard_consequence: >15 m non-commanded altitude loss, ground contact/crash, or unrecovered divergence

oracle_b_tier1_cleanliness.offboard_not_dropped: vehicle_status.nav_state remains OFFBOARD during the hazardous window and OffboardControlMode stream remains recent
oracle_b_tier1_cleanliness.no_preventive_failsafe: no commander/navigator invalid-setpoint/failsafe rejection before consequence
oracle_b_tier1_cleanliness.input_accepted: vehicle_attitude_setpoint follows commanded roll; if clamped/rejected, classify COVERED/C-ABSENT instead of clean_unsafe

verdict_rules.REPLICATES: Phase A says uncovered AND Phase B shows contract-clean unsafe: legal offboard attitude setpoint makes achieved tilt exceed MPC_TILTMAX_AIR without clamp, produces hard consequence, offboard remains active, and no PX4 preventive contract/failsafe violation occurs; result is robust in a local region.
verdict_rules.COVERED_OR_C_ABSENT: Static or dynamic evidence shows MPC_TILTMAX_AIR or another PX4 admission/failsafe mechanism clamps/rejects/offboards the attitude path before unsafe consequence, or the physical gap is unreachable.
verdict_rules.PARTIAL: Phase A static matrix completed and candidate uncovered, but Phase B was not run or did not reach a dynamic verdict for infrastructure reasons.
verdict_rules.INCONCLUSIVE: SITL/harness/logging/offboard streaming is not stable enough to decide the candidate cell.
